results.name: array_lengths
results.sql: SELECT array_length(hashes,1),count(*) FROM otel_logs_and_spans WHERE project_id='87576849-4941-49d3-a15d-680fef88a1a8' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08 16:49:19.701883' - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND timestamp <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08 16:49:19.701883' GROUP BY 1

results.name: top_tags
results.sql: SELECT tag,count(*) FROM (SELECT unnest(hashes) AS tag FROM otel_logs_and_spans WHERE project_id='87576849-4941-49d3-a15d-680fef88a1a8' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08 16:49:19.701883' - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND timestamp <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08 16:49:19.701883') GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
